name: Rows 130 to 141, the architecture page beside the destinations and cadence pages, the language list as a constraint on every wiki page, eleven instrument extensions, the vocabulary line as an audit rule, and twelve findings routed
markdown_description:
**Routed to:** S17 (`86ajgmk27`)

The readiness test stands at one hundred and forty-one rows; row 136's voice half and row 139's second half are read as failed until canon's owner and the founders rule, and row 141 as not yet until a live risk or a statement exists. Session 17's assembly inherits: the communication architecture page (I1) as the wiki's communication page beside the destinations page (`86akht1m9`) and the cadence page (`86akh6755`), which is what Session 3's internal communications policy (`86akh5uev`) and its `86akh5uym` carryover become; the house's language list as a constraint on every wiki page, so that every page the assembly produces exists in every listed language under one version number or is not published; eleven instrument specifications that extend earlier sessions' (I3 extends S8's designation block and S10's rotation floor; I4 extends S7's module standard; I5 extends S8's structure change entry and S9's coupling; I7 extends S4's loop window; I10 extends S6's calibration record; I11 extends S8's live-risk form) and must be assembled as one instrument each; the vocabulary line that "diagnostic" and the modes' names appear on no brief record, recognition, slot item, or close (S11 P27, row 137) as an audit rule beside the "operating system" line (`86akh5uym`); the rule that nothing reaches the house that is not on a record first (A27) beside Session 6's four dimensions, Session 9's order of every read, and Session 10's no-person-in-a-room rule; the composition statement (P35) as one wiki paragraph once ratified and nothing beyond it until `86akh7r8z` is ruled; and twelve findings, two of which surface from a narrow read of the white paper's people and brand sections and ten of which need canon against the record, the record against itself, or the two canon versions against each other, for the assembly's conflicts list (extending `86akht3fx`, `86akhpvvq`, and `86akhcz7t`, not repeating them).

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
